reasons: The four full traces start at a public account value, public migration origin metadata, public claim-signing payload, and Result<()> graph-progress verification. The reported data is public ledger metadata or control/result flow, not a credential string.

DevelopmentIdentity contains a private secret_hex but implements neither Serialize nor Debug. Within production ingress it exposes only a derived public key and signatures; the authenticated request/response envelope never serializes the identity or its secret. The three secret_identity related locations construct this object and do not establish a raw-secret-to-stdout path.
The stdout sink serializes the explicit Value returned by run: public chain/status/account/proof/receipt fields. Related Settings/Node open calls are not serialized wholesale.
